description: Three more faults behind the zero-byte ten-bit rows, found on the device after the colour-format fix: (1) the P010 Image comes as THREE planes (pixelStride 4); the writer pushed the whole interleaved Cb,Cr row through the Cb view, which is one word short at the last row: BufferOverflowException on the first frame. Chroma now goes bulk per row through the Cb view minus its last word, with the last Cr word through the Cr view. (2) The 10-bit value was stored x4 in the LOW bits; P010 wants it in the top ten bits, so levels are now x4 << 6 (the old frames were ~1.4% bright: 1.3 Mb/s at a 140 Mb/s ask). (3) The run's 10 s deadline started at the top of the loop, so slow heavy-content synthesis cut the feed short (19 of 30 frames).
